editorial:
Imagine your marriage is failing and your small business is about to go broke. That is exactly where Sophie and Vincent are when things go from bad to absolutely wild. When a vegan activist starts messing with their butcher shop, a freak accident happens and the activist ends up dead. Instead of calling the police, the couple decides to do something totally insane: they turn the body into ham to hide the evidence. It sounds gross, but the movie plays it for laughs, turning a nightmare scenario into a dark comedy that keeps you guessing. You will feel for the couple as they panic, but you will also laugh at how ridiculous their situation becomes.

The acting is great because the couple feels like real people caught in a crazy spot. The pacing is quick, so you never get bored, though some of the gore might be a bit much if you have a weak stomach. If you love dark humor that pushes boundaries, you need to see this. It is a blast to watch in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture, or you can just rent it on Apple TV for a movie night. If you are a collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your shelf is a great call because the colors and details really pop.
endingExplained: As the business booms, the couple becomes addicted to the success and starts killing more people to keep the meat supply going. Eventually, their greed catches up with them. The movie ends with a twist where they realize they have become the very monsters they feared. They end up trapped by their own crimes, showing that their hunger for money and fame completely destroyed their morals and their lives in the end.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark comedies and twisted plots.
